conceptual_change: Introduce a 0.5% price-buffer threshold for SMA crossover execution, requiring the asset price to deviate by at least 0.5% from the moving average intersection point to confirm trend strength before entry.
rationale: The previous attempt at a trailing stop-loss failed due to implementation complexity; by shifting the conceptual change to an entry-buffer threshold, we maintain the goal of reducing noise-driven signals without requiring new order-type execution logic.
